title: El Manisero - Kempton vendor-call excerpt
edition: Edward B. Marks Music Co., New York, 1930, plate 9737-4
source_location: Printed p. 2, systems 2 and 3 (PDF page 2), eight complete bars beginning at the segno
scope: Piano grand staff and the separate upper vendor-call staff as printed in these eight bars. Play once from the segno to the system-ending double bar.
editorial: Preview tempo is an editorial quarter-note 112 BPM (half-note 56). The cut-time signature is retained.
The syllables under the piano treble stay with that staff. The separately printed call is silent in the first four bars.
In system 2 the paired treble notes are assigned to the two MIDI voices by register. In system 3 the score separates the held upper voice from the moving lower voice by stem direction.
The calls and upper piano D5s are held across the printed ties while the lower part continues. Accent and dynamic marks remain in the source. MIDI uses fixed preview velocity.
